value: Set-level diffusion transformer over gene tokens (gene identity + value MLP + reveal-mask embedding, CLS token), with interleaved cross-attention to six perturbed-gene prior embeddings. X-Cell: 12 layers, d=512, 55M, Post-LN, ReLU FFN, 4 cross-attn layers, initialised from scGPT. X-Cell-Ultra: 34 layers, d=2560, 4.87B, Pre-LN RMSNorm, SwiGLU, QK-Norm, 11 cross-attn layers, tied-embedding output head, trained from scratch.

value: Supervised on paired control/perturbed cell sets (needs perturbation labels). Masked-diffusion-style training: 25/50/75/100% of control values replaced by true perturbed values plus a reveal mask; model reconstructs the full perturbed profile. Loss = MMD (energy distance) + fold-change CCC + per-gene CCC + delta-norm penalty + pseudobulk delta MSE + InfoNCE contrastive + prior-embedding reconstruction (term set differs between X-Cell and X-Cell-Ultra phases). Inference: 4 cumulative remasking steps. Optional test-time adaptation (MMD on control-to-control pairs from target domain).
pointer: bioRxiv v1 · Sec 4.1.3 · "X-Cell is trained with MMD loss, contrastive loss, and prior knowledge reconstruction while X-Cell-Ultra high-effect size curriculum training used all losses"

value: Structured prior: five external embeddings of the perturbed gene injected via cross-attention (GenePT text, ESM-2 protein, STRING network (SPACE), DepMap 24Q4 gene effect, JUMP Cell Painting CRISPRi U2OS) plus a sixth token = gene identity embedding (scGPT-initialised in X-Cell). Cellular context is implicit, taken from the input control cell set (no cell-type or batch label supplied); test-time adaptation to target-domain controls for zero-shot.
